title: Rav Acha the Galilean
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in [Avodah Zarah 3b](https://www.sefaria.org/Avodah_Zarah.3b.9), according to Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim, saying to Rav Nachman bar Yitzchak: “From the day the Temple was destroyed there is no laughter before the Holy One, blessed be He.” The text Hyman uses reads Rav Acha without further designation, and [Yalkut, Isaiah, remez 451](https://www.sefaria.org/Yalkut_Shimoni_on_Nach.451.7) reads Rav Acha of Migdal.[^1]

notes.text: The linked Bavli names Rav Acha without a geographical designation. The linked Yalkut calls him Rabbi Acha with the form בגדלאה, where Hyman gives מגדלאה. Hyman reports the Galilean reading from Ein Yaakov and Dikdukei Soferim.
